door.close.description: Close a generated door model with hinge motion, frame impact, and latch catch.

avoid_when: the door is opening
someone only knocks on the door
another kind of drawer or tray closes
use_when: a wooden or metal door audibly closes
a door shuts and its frame or latch contact should be heard

creak.description: Amount of audible hinge friction or creak during closing.

force.description: Strength of the terminal frame and latch impact.

seed.description: Optional non-negative deterministic variation seed that identifies the generated door. Reuse the same material and seed for its matching open sound.

door.open.description: Open a generated door model with latch, hinge friction, and body resonance.

avoid_when: the door only closes
someone only knocks on the door
a drawer, cabinet, or printer tray opens
use_when: a wooden or metal door audibly opens
a character opens a door and latch or hinge motion should be heard

creak.description: Amount of audible hinge friction or creak from 0 to 1.

force.description: Strength of handle, latch, and mechanical excitation during opening.

seed.description: Optional non-negative deterministic variation seed that identifies the generated door. Reuse the same material and seed for its matching close sound.

avoid_when: the character is running
only a single unrelated impact is described
movement is visual or implied but not audibly relevant
use_when: a character walks and the footsteps are audible
someone approaches, crosses, or leaves a space on foot
the scene explicitly calls for a sequence of walking steps

footwear.description: Footwear making contact with the walking surface.

force.description: Perceived loading and strength of the steps.

interval.description: Approximate spacing in seconds between steps.

seed.description: Optional non-negative deterministic variation seed. Reuse the same seed when reproducible output is required.

surface.description: Floor or ground material being walked on.

impact.knock.description: One or more knocks on a resonant surface.

avoid_when: a door itself opens or closes
the sound is a heavy crash rather than a knock
footsteps are being described
use_when: someone knocks on a door
someone raps or taps on a resonant wall or surface
a small object strikes a resonant surface in a knock-like way

force.description: Strength of each knock; lower values are gentler.

impactor.description: Object or body part making contact with the surface.

interval.description: Approximate spacing in seconds between repeated knocks.

seed.description: Optional non-negative deterministic variation seed. Reuse the same seed when reproducible output is required.

pen.write.description: A pen writing and scratching across paper.

avoid_when: a pencil is specifically required
someone is typing rather than handwriting
the pen is merely picked up but does not write
use_when: a character writes by hand with a pen
pen scratching on paper should be audible
someone scribbles or writes an address or note by hand

duration.description: Approximate duration in seconds of continuous handwriting activity.

pressure.description: Pen-to-paper contact strength from light to heavy.

seed.description: Optional non-negative deterministic variation seed. Reuse the same seed when reproducible output is required.

phone.ring.description: A classic or electronic telephone ring.

avoid_when: a phone merely vibrates
a notification beep or text-message alert is described
a person is already speaking on the phone
use_when: a telephone audibly rings
a phone begins ringing in a scene

interval.description: Approximate spacing in seconds between repeated rings.

seed.description: Optional non-negative deterministic variation seed. Reuse the same seed when reproducible output is required.

style.description: Ring character: classic mechanical-style or electronic.

printer.power_switch.description: Operate a printer power control and its local relay/mechanical response.

avoid_when: the full printer boot or restart sequence is the intended sound
the printer merely wakes from sleep
use_when: someone physically switches a printer off
someone physically switches a printer on
a printer power control and local relay response are audible

seed.description: Optional non-negative deterministic variation seed for switch and relay sounds. Reuse the same seed when reproducible output is required.

state.description: Whether the audible power action switches the printer off or on.

printer.print.description: Feed and print one or more sheets through an office printer.

avoid_when: the printer only displays a message
the printer wakes without printing
the printer performs a reboot or calibration without feeding paper
use_when: an office printer audibly prints one or more sheets
paper is visibly or audibly fed out of a printer
a printer produces a page

pages.description: Number of sheets audibly fed and printed.

seed.description: Optional non-negative deterministic variation seed. Reuse the same seed when reproducible output is required.

printer.restart.description: Printer boot and mechanical calibration sequence after power-on.

avoid_when: only the power button click is needed
the printer merely wakes from sleep
the printer is actively printing pages
use_when: a printer restarts or boots after power-on
a printer performs a substantial startup or calibration sequence

seed.description: Optional non-negative deterministic variation seed for motor and fan sounds. Reuse the same seed when reproducible output is required.

speed.description: Duration and speed of the startup calibration sequence.

printer.tray_open.description: Unlatch and slide open a printer paper tray.

avoid_when: paper is being printed
a normal room door opens
the tray remains closed while paper is checked visually
use_when: someone opens a printer paper tray
a printer paper drawer unlatches and slides open

paper_load.description: Approximate amount of paper in the tray; controls loose paper movement.

seed.description: Optional non-negative deterministic variation seed. Reuse the same seed when reproducible output is required.

speed.description: Speed at which the printer tray slides open.

printer.wake.description: Wake a sleeping printer with a short relay, motor, and fan response.

avoid_when: the printer performs a full power-on restart
paper is actually being printed
only the physical power switch is pressed
use_when: a sleeping printer wakes
a printer comes out of standby without a full reboot
a short relay, fan, or motor response marks printer wake-up

depth.description: Wake response depth; deep has more mechanical activity.

seed.description: Optional non-negative deterministic variation seed. Reuse the same seed when reproducible output is required.
